exclusions.term: P0A/P0B/P0C/P0D wiring and adaptive capabilities outside the C3a-C3h2d delivery-first slice
exclusions.reason: P0A/P0B provide repository primitives and P0C keeps FinalizeRunSuccess AdaptiveGate optional; production finalizers still pass nil. P0D is named-path evidence, not a repository-wide deadlock-free claim. P1M-C1/C2a define mode-free typed contracts and strict codecs; C2b provides private durable bootstrap commit/readback plus generic reserved-fact isolation. C3a-C3d add the fenced fresh Execute bootstrap and make its durable facts authoritative for local Plan/Subagent capability while neutralizing retired reasoning controls. C3e-C3h1a retire Journal mode consumers and stop public, child and recovery target new writes from persisting the seven retired controls. C3h2a-C3h2c add typed Resume inheritance, atomic Human rollover and legacy exact-miss fallback; dev disposable MySQL verifies Human rollover plus typed and legacy recovery races. C3h2d makes production ADK Factory, Middleware, standard Subagent provider and builtin definition ignore top-level requested_policy/mode, and removes those keys from builtin/single-agent child writers while keeping explicit server-owned Plan/Subagent/reasoning/model configuration. C3h2d also extends the repository primitive for B1/B2/B3 same-recovery rolling Plan, immutable historical replay and a rolling checkpoint as the next Attempt recovery source with strict lineage, revision/version, fingerprint and event-anchor validation. It does not connect ApplicationADKPlanStore or ADKCheckpointStore to CommitAdaptiveExecutionBoundary; no production path yet submits the complete Plan mutation, Eino checkpoint and event in that single fenced transaction. Ordinary non-Journal enrollment, gate-on producer, the Application rolling writer, Adaptive finalizer gate and a true server inference policy remain unwired, so P1M is not PASS. P1L remains deferred and canonical whole-Thread DELETE stays hard-disabled pending the unresolved idle-cascade lock order.
